title: Users & access
grantLinkMsg: Email isn't configured - share this one-time setup link with the user:
pickUser: Select a user to see their access.
confirmDeleteUser: Delete {{email}}? This removes all their recordings.
protectedPlatformAdmin: The Platform Administrator can't be disabled or deleted.
protectedSelf: You can't disable or delete your own account.
groupSystemHint: This group is required. Its permissions can't be changed and its last member can't be removed.
pickGroup: Select a group on the left, or create a new one.
rmPickRoom: Select a room on the left, or create a new one.
rmDeleteConfirm: Type "{{name}}" to confirm deletion. Recordings shared here are unshared, never deleted.
permHintManageRooms: Create shared rooms, and add or remove their members.
permHintManageUsers: Invite users, approve access requests, disable accounts, set quotas.
permHintManagePlatform: Platform-wide settings, model defaults, integrations, backup and restore.
permHintManageFormulas: Edit the built-in and platform-wide formulas everyone can run.
permManagePeopleHint: Browse and edit the People directory - the speakers heard in meetings, not platform users. Opting yourself out of voice-printing never needs this.
permManageVoiceprintsHint: Assess and tune how voices are recognised. Includes playing short clips of a person's speech in recordings you do not own, which is logged. It grants nothing else in those recordings.
confirmDeleteGroup: Delete the group "{{name}}"? Its members keep their accounts.
identificationIntro: How sure Diariz has to be before it names a voice. Distances are cosine distances - lower means a closer match.
identThresholdLabel: Accept a match at or below
identThresholdHint: Below this distance the name is applied automatically. Lower is stricter.
identBandLabel: Ask about a match up to
identBandHint: Between the two, Diariz asks instead of naming. Set it equal to the threshold for no questions at all.
identMarginHint: How far the best match must beat the next person before either is used. Guards against two similar voices.
identMinSpeechHint: A voice needs this much speech before it is matched at all. Very short utterances are unreliable.
rescanIntro: Identification runs when a recording is transcribed, so enrolling someone does not revisit earlier recordings. A re-scan applies the current settings to everything already transcribed. It only adds names - it never removes one.
rescanPreviewResult: This would name {{applied}} and ask about {{suggested}}.
identThresholdInvalid: The acceptance distance must be between 0 and 2.
identBandInvalid: The ask-about distance can't be stricter than the acceptance distance.
